Reply inline:
- Median/95th token lengths (from sampled 10k requests):
  - triage-chat: median 120 tokens / 95th 610 tokens
  - summary: median 340 tokens / 95th 1,220 tokens
  - med-recon: median 90 tokens / 95th 420 tokens
- Peak traffic (we expect a phased rollout):
  - Pilot week: 45 rpm avg, peaks ~120 rpm sustained for 10–15 min windows per hour
  - Production target (Q4 ramp): 600 rpm avg with multi-hour peaks ~2,500 rpm
- Latency: front-facing triage needs 95th < 750 ms (user-facing). Back-office batch summaries can be 2s.

Files attached: cypress_token_profile.csv, sample_payloads.json (large — we provided subset).

Couple of asks back: can Redwood provide a recommended token budget per user session (P50/P95) and a short model cost delta between a 8k vs 16k context candidate? Also curious what rollback policy you suggest if P95 latency crosses 900 ms.

Thanks — Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Kickoff — model shortlist, token cadence & windowing (Cypress Health)

Alex / team — jumping in with a concise model shortlist and a suggested token cadence per session. Below are our working estimates for sprint-0 planning (we tested against your sample payloads and scaled to your projected rpm).

Model shortlist (primary candidates):
- rwd-vicuna-8k-q4 (8k context) — best latency/cost for triage-chat; P50 token per session: 180; P95: 540
- rwd-llama-16k-opt (16k context) — useful if you want richer in-session context for summaries; P50 token per session: 420; P95: 1,100
- open-highlight-32k (32k context, quantized) — reserved for med-recon long-history sessions; higher cost, expect 2.1x token cost vs 8k candidate

Hourly token cadence (pilot week / production target):
- Pilot (45 rpm avg, peaks 120): estimated hourly tokens = ~1.1M tokens/hr (P95 workloads considered)
- Prod target (600 rpm avg): estimated hourly tokens = ~14.4M tokens/hr
- Multi-hour peak (2,500 rpm sustained): estimated hourly tokens = ~60M tokens/hr

Recommendation on 8k vs 16k context:
- If most of your use is triage + short summaries, start with 8k for pilot (lower cost, faster tails).
- Move to 16k for the summary route only (route-level model assignment) once day-1 correctness regressions are low.

Rollback / degradation policy (suggested):
- Canary at 10% of traffic, monitor token/latency heatmap and 95th latency.
- If P95 latency > 900 ms for >10 minutes OR error rate delta > 1.5x baseline, auto-fallback to smaller context variant (8k) and open alert.
- Maintain a TTL'd cache for recent prefixes to reduce token churn during bursts.

Attachments: redwood_model_shortlist_recs.pdf (contains microbenchmarks we ran).

Next steps I propose:
1) Jonas to lock MAP and canary dates after Cypress confirms pilot-week traffic days.
2) Grace to run a quick cost delta for 8k vs 16k across monthly projected tokens (we'll attach a simple cost sheet).
3) Alex to confirm whether med-recon needs long-history sessions (if not, we can avoid 32k candidate).

Happy to jump on a quick 30-min sync — I can do tomorrow 10–11am PT.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
